notes: Machine-readable view of the action registry. A router selects a registered action_id from here; arbitrary shell commands are forbidden. Keep in sync with ACTION_REGISTRY.md.

actions.description: Согласованный финальный перенос: история, собственные .env, инструменты, команды hermes и переключение Telegram Gateway на новый University.
actions.when_to_use: Только утверждённый пользователем план перехода на самостоятельные агенты.
actions.input_schema: Existing old/new homes; preserved shared runtime/OAuth; protected backup; current systemd unit.
actions.permissions: Scoped backup and state copy for five new agents; native profile aliases for shared OAuth without token copying; private .env detachment; launcher and bash alias updates; systemd user Gateway stop/drop-in/start for University, preserving outbound restrictions. No old-home deletion, no MCP/model tests, no push. Keep rollback and read back exact saved targets/service state.
actions.verification: File/SQLite preservation and credential-reference metadata; command home selection; new University Gateway PID/home and connection status; no private data in Git. No LLM or MCP calls.

actions.description: Разрешённый пользователем пилот прямого Architect: реализация установщика, focused tests, установка и проверка отдельного home.
actions.when_to_use: Только согласованный пилот Architect; действие не разрешает перенос других профилей.
actions.input_schema: Source Architect home; empty target home; versioned definitions; provisioned Hermes launcher; existing test interpreter.
actions.permissions: Scoped file edits in scripts/direct_agent.py, tests/scripts/install/test_direct_agent.py, runtime-config/agents/architect and docs/direct-agents; scoped terminal commands for implementation, syntax/lint, canonical focused tests, local Git review/commit, SQLite backup/integrity/hash/FTS checks, offline prompt inspection, provisioned Hermes config operations, direct launcher and read-only MCP/model smoke. Source profile read-only; runtime writes only to /home/vottak/Проекты/Hermes-workspace/agents/architect, protected pilot backups and scratch; unique architect-direct launcher may be installed in ~/.local/bin. No secret printing or credential copying, no changes to other profiles, no Gateway/AG2 restart, no push or new paid services.
actions.verification: Focused tests; actual target home and launcher readback; preserved memory/history/FTS/resources; source unchanged; MCP and bounded direct launch; no private runtime state in Git. Report unverified criteria explicitly.

actions.description: Сложные, новые, междисциплинарные или неуверенно маршрутизируемые задачи.
actions.when_to_use: Нет подходящего точного action_id или confidence маршрута низкий.
actions.input_schema: Current request plus minimal permitted context.
actions.verification: Compare result with original user goal and QUALITY_POLICY.md.

actions.description: Передать визуальную задачу из Main или будущего JEV в изолированный профиль Design Agent.
actions.when_to_use: Дизайн, сайт, презентация, портфолио, визуальная система, графика, layout, branding или visual editing.
actions.input_schema: Original user request verbatim; explicit attachments; minimal routing metadata and project context.
actions.permissions: Inherit design profile contract and PERMISSIONS.md; no Main memory inheritance.
actions.verification: Result comes from profile design; original request hash is preserved; no unrelated Main context is included.

actions.description: Прямая работа Main в Blender через MCP по явной просьбе пользователя, без design.route.
actions.when_to_use: Пользователь явно просит выполнять Blender-задачу непосредственно в Main; остальные визуальные запросы остаются в design.route.
actions.input_schema: User request; explicit project and references; requested animation timing and verification frames.
actions.permissions: Inherit PERMISSIONS.md; verify workspace and port; checkpoint before edits; one scene writer; no arbitrary deletion, paid services or source overwrite.
actions.verification: get_scene_info before edits; static composition checked with look camera/angles before keyframes; look frames 1,24,48,72,96 and final; saved blend and preview verified.

actions.description: Создать и проверить карточку товара или комплект изображений для маркетплейса через subordinate-агента Design Agent.
actions.when_to_use: Карточка товара, листинг, маркетплейс, Amazon A+, инфографика товара, size chart, lifestyle, banner или комплект ecommerce-изображений.
actions.input_schema: Original request; platform/market/language; explicit product references; verified product facts and exact copy; output path; explicit USER approval and stated maximum budget for any paid generation or external upload.
actions.permissions: Design profile contract; project-scoped files; paid generation or external upload only after explicit USER approval and a stated maximum budget; otherwise NEEDS_APPROVAL.
actions.verification: Every output file exists and is visually checked for product identity, exact text, platform dimensions/rules and unsupported claims; Design Agent performs the final quality gate.

actions.when_to_use: Нет утверждённого baseline/design system или пользователь явно просит новую концепцию.
actions.input_schema: Design brief, audience, verified facts, permissions, assets, format and languages.
actions.permissions: Design profile contract plus project-scoped files and approved external generation.
actions.verification: Real artifact render, facts, assets, language and links are checked; paid generation requires prior approval.

actions.description: Расширить существующее инженерное портфолио без редизайна.
actions.when_to_use: Утверждённые baseline и design system существуют; добавляется новый контент.
actions.input_schema: Existing design system, approved baseline, new verified content and explicit project context.
actions.permissions: Design profile contract and project-scoped edits.
actions.verification: New content follows the existing system; affected render is checked; Superdesign is not called by default.

actions.description: Выполнить минимальную локальную правку инженерного портфолио.
actions.when_to_use: Точное изменение текста, числа, ссылки, изображения или локального стиля.
actions.input_schema: Existing artifact target and exact requested replacement.
actions.permissions: Design profile contract and minimal project-scoped edit.
actions.verification: Requested literal or asset changed only in intended locations; local render checked; no redesign tools called.

actions.description: Для кодовой задачи выполнить быстрые проверки локально и проверить долгие тесты в GitHub Actions ближе к завершению тикета.
actions.when_to_use: Работа в GitHub-репозитории, особенно implementation ticket перед закрытием или PR review.
actions.input_schema: Repository and remote ref; ticket/PR; available workflow; latest intended commit SHA; quick local check results.
actions.permissions: Read repository/CI state; workflow dispatch only when authorized by the request and repo policy; no push without explicit authorization.
actions.verification: GitHub Actions run is terminal; repository, workflow, branch/ref and head SHA match intended ticket commit; conclusion and artifacts/status checks read back from GitHub.
